teaser.en: One of three Keetia shrubs that Digo speakers group together under one name.
teaser.sw: Mojawapo ya vichaka vitatu vya Keetia ambavyo Wadigo huviweka pamoja chini ya jina moja.

summary.en: This mnyundzu is Keetia venosa, a shrub of the coffee family. Pakia records one Digo name, mnyundzu, for three species of Keetia.
summary.sw: Mnyundzu huu ni Keetia venosa, kichaka cha familia ya mibuni. Pakia anaandika jina moja la Kidigo, mnyundzu, kwa spishi tatu za Keetia.

about.en:
*Keetia venosa* is a shrub, small tree or scrambler. Its leaves often have a conspicuous network of veins, which is what *venosa* refers to.

Like other plants of the genus, it has opposite leaves with small stipules between the leaf stalks, small greenish-white flowers in clusters at the leaf bases, and small fleshy fruits that are often two-lobed and ripen to black. Pakia's informants identified the *mnyundzu* plants by their leaves and fruits.
about.sw:
*Keetia venosa* ni kichaka, mti mdogo au mmea unaotambaa juu ya mingine. Mara nyingi majani yake yana mtandao wa mishipa unaoonekana wazi, na hiyo ndiyo maana ya *venosa*.

Kama mimea mingine ya jenasi hii, ina majani yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana yenye vikanzu vidogo (stipuli) katikati ya vikonyo vya majani, maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-nyeupe katika vishada kwenye vishina vya majani, na matunda madogo yenye nyama ambayo mara nyingi yana pande mbili na huiva kuwa meusi. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliitambua mimea ya *mnyundzu* kwa majani na matunda yake.

where.en: It is widespread in tropical Africa and grows in forest, thicket and bushland, including on the Kenya coast.
where.sw: Imeenea sana katika Afrika ya kitropiki na inaota misituni, katika vichaka vizito na vichaka, ikiwemo pwani ya Kenya.

names.en: Pakia gives *mnyundzu* for three *Keetia* species: *K. lukei*, *K. venosa* and *K. zanzibarica*. To Digo speakers they are one kind of plant. He gives no meaning for the name, and no other language shares it. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa *mnyundzu* kwa spishi tatu za *Keetia*: *K. lukei*, *K. venosa* na *K. zanzibarica*. Kwa Wadigo, hizi ni aina moja ya mmea. Hatoi maana ya jina hili, na hakuna lugha nyingine inayolitumia. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.

reason.en: Vangueria, a close relative in the coffee family
reason.sw: Vangueria, jamaa wa karibu katika familia ya mibuni

reason.en: Rytigynia, of the same group of the coffee family
reason.sw: Rytigynia, wa kundi lilelile la familia ya mibuni

digo_proposals.name: Mnyundzu
digo_proposals.note: also given for Keetia lukei, Keetia zanzibarica
